title: Repair Candle tensor byte ownership, malformed input validation and F8 conversion recursion
goal: Eliminate unsafe pointer copies and reconstructed Vec ownership in vendored candle-core safetensors buffer decoding, enforce pre-decode alignment and overflow validation across numeric dtypes, and replace recursive F8-to-F64 trait dispatch with inherent float8 conversion (landed across 5486401ecec5cba78130593b7834d9fedcaa6d05..57468e3a29f7a01d971082ccda61b2be8283edce; crates/susi-gemi/tests/tensor_byte_boundary.rs and active candle-core workspace linkage later migrated to Commercial susi-gpu-fabric in 71d7a90bd1583487deb7a7c46ce597bdd53557df).
notes: crates/susi-gemi/tests/tensor_byte_boundary.rs and active candle-core workspace membership migrated out of Lean Core to Commercial susi-gpu-fabric in 71d7a90bd1583487deb7a7c46ce597bdd53557df (vendor/candle-core remains retained on disk under exclude = ["vendor"] and is verified at the Core boundary by architecture_tests::the_lockfile_carries_fixed_zip_and_the_approved_candle_sources).

reuse.justification: Patched the retained vendored candle-core safetensors and dtype modules directly using self_cell-owned byte buffers and inherent float8 conversions without adding new dependencies or unsafe blocks.
